conclusions: v1_skip_loads (fetch only window frames, grid 44->14) is the champion: 17.31 ms, 1.87x vs splash
BQ curve in the v1 family has its minimum at 1024 (512:19.97, 768:17.74, 1024:17.31, 2048:17.87) -- opposite direction to the fetch-all family, where smaller BQ won
finer compute chunks lose: BKV_COMPUTE 360 is 12% slower than 600 at the same BQ

r3b full/partial block split is the new champion at 16.60 ms (1.95x vs splash): interior blocks skip the element mask entirely; the last-frame block is always fully allowed since window rows and reference rows together cover every q row
the scalar-saturation hypothesis mostly failed: hoisting predicates to block level was neutral (compiler already did it) and hpt=1 hurt (register pressure was not binding; 5x grid steps cost more)
champion profile: compute_ratio 0.947, MXU 29%, scalar_alu 97.7% utilization -- utilization is not the critical path
